Then they built something permanent. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Google Sheets stores orders. Crypto payments verify on-chain. The system doesn’t ask for your location. It doesn’t care. Why the Popular Advice Is Wrong

‘Use a friend’s PayPal account.’ ‘Find a VPN.’ ‘Beg someone in the US to collect for you.’ This advice is temporary. It’s fragile. It’s not a business. Bangladeshi freelancers tried these methods. PayPal accounts got suspended. VPNs triggered fraud alerts. Middlemen took 30% cuts. They realized the problem wasn’t their location. It was their architecture. They switched to Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Supabase for databases. NOWPayments for crypto. The result? Instant global payments. No intermediaries. No platform dependency. What the Architecture and Experience Actually Show

Here’s how it works: A customer in Germany buys your ebook. Payment is sent in USDT on the TRON network. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. Cloudflare Workers trigger file delivery from R2 storage. The order is logged in Supabase. You get paid. No platform touched the process. No one asked your location. No one took a cut except the blockchain network—0.5%. Bangladeshi creators use this daily. COREMERCH built it into stacks. The Sovereign Starter Stack deploys in 48 hours. The Edge Commerce Stack adds SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability. The Complete Builder Kit gives you all six blueprints. Full source code. Scaling playbook. Platforms rent you access. They can take it away. PayPal froze $20 million from Nigerian freelancers in 2023. Stripe shut down accounts in Kenya without warning. These weren’t bugs. They were business decisions. Bangladeshi creators stopped renting. They started owning. GitHub Pages hosts their stores. Google Apps Script handles logic. Crypto payments bypass banks. COREMERCH’s stacks are their model. No platform fees. No geographic blocks. No one can shut you down. The Complete Builder Kit is their architecture. Deploy it. Own it. Run it.
